diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default has an explicit depends_on on aws_s3_bucket.origin, but it already depends on that bucket implicitly: its origin block sets domain_name = local.bucket_domain_name, and local.bucket_domain_name resolves through local.bucket to aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id. Terraform infers the same ordering from that attribute reference, so the explicit depends_on is redundant and can be removed.
